compare.exclude_fields_reason: Cross-language RNG (Python MT vs Rust Xoshiro256++) — intent triple diverges by design (monsters.rs:22-29 / inflight-briefing §9).
compare.step_exclude_fields_reason: sts2-rs-rggx: per-step shape lock — Python MT vs Rust Xoshiro256++ roll different intent branches across the 10-turn walk, so damage-derived fields (hp/block/is_alive/powers) and post-game-over freeze fields (/round, player.energy, player.max_energy) are excluded. Only structural shape (type tag, top-level keys, enemy id/max_hp, pile counts, player/max_hp, hand) is byte-locked.
